record.name: Brunei
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. AITI, the telecoms and ICT authority, published a voluntary AI governance and ethics guide in April 2025 and no AI-specific regulator or evaluation body was found.

related_bodies.name: Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam (AITI)
related_bodies.role: It issued the AI governance and ethics guide with an AI Governance and Ethics Working Group. It is an ICT sector authority.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. The English query found AITI's governance working group and guide, cybersecurity guidance and a healthcare proof of concept. These are governance and deployment initiatives, not a qualifying national institute or institute-specific commitment. The cybersecurity and healthcare results were search excerpts only; the selected AITI governance source was read. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded ms query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The ISEAS passage reports AITI's own guide. It does not establish an independent origin for institute-status evidence. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: AITI identifies the AI Governance and Ethics Working Group and its national governance guide. The primary page does not itself establish that the guide is voluntary.

record.notes: The AITI page does not say whether the guide is voluntary; the ISEAS Perspective (secondary) describes Brunei's guidance as voluntary. A Data and AI Strategy was reported as in preparation in mid-2025 but no published version was found. Searched in English and Malay terms.
